newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria budget deficit tops '96 goal by 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria budget deficit tops '96 goal by 5.4 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit overshot the 1996 target by 5.4 percent on October 17, finance ministry figures showed.
Deficit rose by 3.2 billion levs to 85.1 billion levs between end-September and mid-October against an annual target of 80.7 billion levs.

Expenditure rose by 28.3 billion levs to 310.9 billion levs in the first half of October or 70.8 percent of the year goal while revenue grew by 25 billion levs to 225.8 billion levs or 63 percent of target.
No further details were immediately available.
Bulgaria's parliament in July revised the annual budget in a move to meet high foreign and domestic debt payments and to keep structural reform on track.
Some 52.6 percent of total expenditure in the revised annual budget or 231 billion levs were allocated to cover interest payments on foreign and domestic debt. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
